sn55.29:1.1: Sāvatthinidānam || || 2. Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupa- || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || ekam antam nisīdiṃsu || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā etad avoca || || 3--6. ||pe || la || || 7.
sn55.29:1.2: Yato kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa imāni pañcabhayāni verāni vūpasantāni honti || imehi catuhi sotāpattiyaṅgehi samannāgato hoti || ayaṃ cassa ariyo ñāyo paññāya sudiṭṭho hoti supaṭividdho || || So ākaṅkamāno attanā va attānaṃ vyākareyya
sn55.29:1.3: Khīṇanirayo mhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapittivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto sotāpanno ham asmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano
